0022600113.text: The Brooklyn Nets (0-1, 10th in the East and 1.5 games back in the Atlantic) host the Indiana Pacers (1-1, 9th in the East and one game back in the Central) in a matchup that is not a season opener for either team. Tyler Bilodeau is out for Brooklyn with a shoulder injury, while Indiana is missing Ben Sheppard (knee), Johnny Furphy (knee, surgery), and T.J. McConnell (hamstring), and Aaron Nesmith is day-to-day with a hamstring strain and is a game-time decision. Brooklyn lost 1-2 to Indiana in the 2025-26 season series, including a 123-94 loss in Brooklyn on April 9, 2026, and the two teams have not met yet in 2026-27.
